strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚,{NEWLINE}电话坏了吗？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打试试！
strings.en: Hm? I can’t hear you very{NEWLINE}well. Is the phone broken?{SCROLL}Please try calling again{NEWLINE}from somewhere else.

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}啊,是你啊,{CLEAR}我身体很好。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello...{NEWLINE}Ah, it’s you. I am in fine health.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你不是还有其他{NEWLINE}没有打败的道馆馆主吗？{CLEAR}快去打败他们吧！
strings.en: Aren’t there other Gym Leaders you{NEWLINE}have yet to defeat? Go and beat them!

strings.zh: 嗯⋯⋯我在{NEWLINE}礼拜六早上还有点空,{CLEAR}到时候打电话给我吧。
strings.en: Let’s see... I’m free Saturday mornings{NEWLINE}usually.{CLEAR}Please, give me a call then.

strings.zh: 正好我现在很闲,{NEWLINE}来！{CLEAR}我们再来对战一次！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I happen to be free right now.{NEWLINE}Come! Let us battle once more! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 很好很好！{NEWLINE}我感到热血沸腾。{SCROLL}我在战斗前线的训练家屋{NEWLINE}等你哦！
strings.en: Very good! My blood is boiling.{SCROLL}I will be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: US 0648/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.en: I see... You must be busy as well.

strings.zh: 话说⋯⋯{NEWLINE}在和我战斗之前{CLEAR}你不是还有其他的{CLEAR}预约要完成吗？
strings.en: I’ve got to say this...{NEWLINE}Before we battle again, how about you{CLEAR}keep any promises you made to{CLEAR}others first?

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的训练家屋等你！{CLEAR}说定了！
strings.en: I will be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier. It is a promise!
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 喂,是我,阿速！{NEWLINE}你最近身体怎么样？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hey, this is Falkner.{NEWLINE}How are you doing?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋对战的吗？{CLEAR}难道你忘了？
strings.en: Did we not agree to battle at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier?{CLEAR}Surely you have not forgotten?
strings.notes: US 0648/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 在我小的时候,{NEWLINE}我父亲曾和我说过,{SCROLL}阿速,所谓鸟精灵,{NEWLINE}并非是用他们的翅膀在飞。{CLEAR}而是在用他们一颗{CLEAR}想要飞到天上去的心飞翔。{SCROLL}不愧是我的父亲,{NEWLINE}讲的东西太高深了！
strings.en: When I was little, my{NEWLINE}father told me something.{SCROLL}“Falkner, bird Pokémon do not fly{NEWLINE}with their wings. They fly with hearts{CLEAR}that long to soar into the sky.”{SCROLL}My father’s words always run so deep!

strings.zh: 我的道馆在很高的地方,{CLEAR}通行很不方便吧？{SCROLL}每年大扫除的时候{NEWLINE}真是累死人了。{SCROLL}不过有鸟精灵们帮助我,{CLEAR}总算是轻松了点。
strings.en: My Gym sits up high, so it’s{NEWLINE}not easy to get to, is it?{SCROLL}The big cleaning every{NEWLINE}year is exhausting.{SCROLL}But with my bird Pokémon{NEWLINE}helping, it’s a little easier.

strings.zh: 你和浅红市的阿杏　{NEWLINE}聊过了吧？{SCROLL}无论和她聊什么,{NEWLINE}她都会讲自己{CLEAR}父亲的故事。{SCROLL}真是的⋯⋯{SCROLL}虽然尊敬自己的父亲{NEWLINE}不失为一件好事啦。{CLEAR}不过我还是很想和她说,{CLEAR}要对自己有自信啊！{SCROLL}你对自己的实力{NEWLINE}有自信吗？
strings.en: You’ve chatted with Janine in Fuchsia{NEWLINE}City, haven’t you?{SCROLL}No matter what you talk to her about,{NEWLINE}she ends up telling stories about{CLEAR}her father.{SCROLL}Honestly... I mean, respecting your{NEWLINE}father is a fine thing.{SCROLL}But I still want to tell her to have{NEWLINE}some confidence in herself!{SCROLL}Do you have confidence in your{NEWLINE}own strength?
